messages:
ReleaseBot: Scheduled UNPIN request: runtime v2.16.3 -> unpinned for model-group=gptx-lite at 3190092000 UTC. Requestor: Lina. Reason: upstream kernel hotfix validated in canary; sdk=3.1.4 compatibility confirmed. Auto-unpin window: staged across regions over 2h.

Lina: Quick context: we pinned runtime yesterday after OOMs for gptx-lite-8k-quant. Kernel fix merged in runtime 2.16.4 and test matrix passes. We want to begin staged unpin tonight in low-traffic regions.

Tomas: Are we sure dedicated customers in ap-southeast are ok? Their agents still on SDK 3.2.x. Need a compatibility check.

Zoe: I ran the compatibility runner vs SDK 3.2.0 and runtime 2.16.4. There are 2 flaky tests around kv_cache boundary. Failing rate ~0.6%.

SRE-Oncall: Suggest we do staged unpin with a canary gating: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 45m per region. If errors exceed 1% for decode_error or kv_resync, pause and rollback.

QA: Adding gating checklist: smoke 200 requests with mixed prompt lengths, perf baseline, and one heavy longseq. Capture envoy logs and kv cache metrics.

DevPlatform: We can publish a temporary compatibility shim: env var REDWOOD_KV_STRICT=false which preserves legacy kv deserialization for SDK 3.2.x clients. Can be toggled per-region via feature-flag.

ReleaseBot: Note: feature-flag created ff-3190090000-kv-compat. Default off.

Lina: Proposal: enable shim in ap-southeast only during canary to avoid impacting dedicated customers. Then run SDK compatibility job for 24h. If stable, unpin globally.

ProductLead: Product ok with targeted shim; need comms to partners: short note that a temporary compatibility flag is enabled to support older SDK clients. No user data impact.

Support: Please prepare a short KB blurb and a customer-facing template for partners on dedicated plans.

Tomas: Ops question: who will clear the feature-flag and perform full unpin? Ownership?

Lina: I'll own the unpin rollout and the flag toggles. Tomas + SRE will own rollback/runbook. QA will sign off.

DevPlatform: Command to start staged unpin (dry-run): `releasectl start-unpin --model-group gptx-lite --from-runtime 2.16.3 --to-runtime 2.16.4 --regions ap-southeast,eu-west,us-east --stages 5,25,100 --flag ff-3190090000-kv-compat:on --dry-run`

ReleaseBot: Dry-run accepted. Validations: rollout plan sanity ok.

Lina: Kicking off real rollout in 10m. Will post progress.

ReleaseBot: Rollout started. Stage ap-southeast 5% (canary) job job-3190090101.

Lina: Can we keep pin liftoff window at night but notify oncall? @SRE-Oncall please monitor thresholds.

SRE-Oncall: Monitoring. Alert if decode_error_rate >1% OR p95 latency increases by >20%.

QA: Canary smoke ok at t+6m. No decode errors in 200 requests.

Zoe: Compat runner still showing the 0.6% flake, but that's resolved when the flag is on.

DevPlatform: Flag toggled on in ap-southeast for canary.

ReleaseBot: Update: job-3190090101 success; proceeding to 25% stage in ap-southeast.

Support: Sent partner note to dedicated-customers-ap: 'Temporary compatibility flag enabled for ap-southeast to support older SDKs; no action required.'

Tomas: Given the flag and canary results, I support proceeding with global unpin. But let's keep the flag available as an escape hatch.

Lina: Agreed. Plan: complete staged unpin across eu-west and us-east over next 90m, leave ff-3190090000 available for 48h. Postmortem if any regression.

ReleaseBot: Final note: UNPIN completed in eu-west and us-east; global runtime now 2.16.4 for model-group=gptx-lite. Flag ff-3190090000 remains ON in ap-southeast and OFF elsewhere.

Lina: Closing thread. Will file INF-5031 with timeline, metrics, and recommended SDK note: 'Clients on SDK >=3.1.4 recommended; earlier SDKs supported via compatibility flag.'

ReleaseBot: Closing job job-3190090101.
